    theorem ZFib.CEP.quotientLiftCoordinateEstimates_holds {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) :
    QuotientLiftCoordinateEstimates τ

    The D2 coordinate estimate for a quotient lift. The tolerance is chosen epsilon-delta style, small enough to absorb the quotient multiplicative defect and the trace-transfer representative error before finite ultrafilter concentration selects one coordinate.

    source
    theorem ZFib.CEP.amenableTraceUCP_of_LLP_of_connesEmbeddable' {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (τ : TracialState A) (hLift : HasStarHomApproxUCPLift A) (hCE : ConnesEmbeddable τ) :
    IsAmenableTraceUCP τ

    Faithful extraction, unconditional in the D2 estimate.

    Connes-embeddability of a trace on a C*-algebra with the local lifting property yields u.c.p. matrix microstates (the faithful, Brown Thm 3.1.6 amenable-trace notion). The D2 coordinate estimate is now discharged (quotientLiftCoordinateEstimates_holds), so the only remaining hypotheses are HasLLP A (a domain property) and ConnesEmbeddable τ — ConnesEmbeddable is untouched, and no liftability field is smuggled onto the embedding.
